whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: Okay, hello followers, collectors, people of interest of my holographic artwork. I appreciate you. If you landed on this page that means that you're curious at the very minimum. And if you're not familiar with me, my name is Travis. I am the artist behind Laser Boy Hollow. Currently, I want to inform everybody I'm in the middle of moving. This is a lot going on, okay? And there's two major things that I'm just trying to convey with this message. One, any shipment or any orders that came in today from now on, I got about 10 days to pack this place up and get it into a truck. So any orders that happen today are probably not going to be going out for about three weeks, okay? Probably four weeks because I don't want to... it's going to be a big overhaul, basically. We're going to be rebuilding the lab. It's going to be exciting and fun, but also I won't be able to be producing product within that time frame, right? I don't think. Please be patient. Second thing, major thing, is that your support is incredibly appreciated during this time. It is very financially burdening to move 2,000 plus miles across the country with your entire livelihood, your business. This is what I built, right? This is an art piece in itself. It means something important to me. Again, I just want to say that I appreciate your patience and your support, and we're going to be throwing a lot of cool stuff on the store in the short term because I don't want to transport everything. So you're going to see some products that might not be released, some products that might be prototypes, and I hope that you're excited to kind of pick those things up and maybe have a little piece of the process, as well as some... one-of-one gems. Thank you, and wish me luck.
